prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Australian woman — the personification of the city of Sydney — one woman who IS Sydney as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a sharp, striking, intense look; fair skin; face with soft jaw angles that taper gently toward a rounded chin, not wide from the front; softly deep-set eyes of natural size; storm-grey eyes; full brows set slightly low over the eyes; a straight nose with a slim bridge; softly full, heart-shaped lips of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: broad-shouldered and strong build; a cropped side-parted pixie with a distinct tapered nape; crimson-red hair.
Expression: A steady, unsmiling gaze.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: grand, opulent dress of a mythic court cut to the outfit silhouette below — rich silk brocade dense with gold-thread embroidery, gilded filigree and jewel settings, enchanted jewelry with a soft magical glow; the city's symbol worked into the embroidery and jewels.
City motif: a tall standing collar of overlapping white sail-shaped shells rising behind her head and shoulders, tiled in a fine chevron of glossy white and matte cream like the sail-roofed palace of song on the harbour; a gown of layered harbour-blue panels rippling like waves, embroidered in silver with falling jacaranda blossoms.
World marks on her: layered gold-thread embroidery; a jeweled hair ornament; flowing silk ribbons trailing in the air; heraldic emblems worked in gold; glowing enchanted jewelry; heavy silk brocade; gilded filigree; a jeweled pendant with silk tassels at her waist; banners and royal regalia; a shimmer of magical light.
Silhouette: full plate armor from neck to feet with big rounded pauldrons and a short heraldic tabard — a solid knight's silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: A single load-bearing arch-shaped ridge in the breastplate terminates in squared granite-hued shoulder anchors, like the harbour bridge span seen head-on. Keep the rounded pauldrons compact and the short tabard distinct over clearly visible plate greaves.
Colours: harbour blue, sail white, jacaranda violet — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a slender gold sceptre topped with a pearl-white shell shaped like a furled sail; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her outfit opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, and a high slit or a short hem showing the thigh; the ornaments stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a radiant harbour capital of a myth-world on a vast deep-blue harbour of countless coves at golden sunset: on a point at the water's edge a white palace of song roofed with great curved shells rising like wind-filled sails, their tiles a fine chevron of glossy white and matte cream glowing gold in the low sun; across the water a colossal single arch of grey stone and dark iron spanning the harbour between four tall granite-faced towers, lanterns strung along it; white-sailed ships and gilded ferries gliding between honey-coloured sandstone shores and green headlands; terraced sandstone streets lined with jacaranda trees in violet bloom; far inland, mountains veiled in a soft blue haze; violet blossoms and golden spirit lights drifting over the water.
This card: on the broad stone steps of the white palace of song at sunset, its great sail-like shells soaring behind her and the deep-blue harbour glittering gold beyond.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: She stands squarely across two broad steps, sceptre vertical near her right hip and left hand resting openly over her belt.
Setting detail: The low sun picks out the pale edges of the nearby stone steps and the iron harbour arch behind her.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: corset, modern material, machinery, second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin, smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.
